title: Scoreboard remembers the tie
lede: The same completed-game fixture now carries a soccer tie through the record, meter, filter, and recent form without turning it into a loss.

stats.n: Ties are resolved games and appear as a third record value only when present.
The server-owned win rate counts a tie as half a win.
Same fixture, simulator, device, and screenshot UI test; only tie handling changes.

sections.heading: The season card tells the truth
sections.note: Matched DEBUG fixture capture from the clean HEAD baseline and the current implementation. Both use the existing ScoreboardScreenshotUITests harness on iPhone 16 Pro / iOS 26.5; the fixture includes one soccer TIE in both captures.

pairs.title: Record, meter, filter, and form
pairs.sub: A red literal TIE becomes a first-class orange result without changing the surrounding season story.
pairs.beforeCap: The baseline renders the tie as a red literal TIE, keeps the record at W–L, and has no tie filter or meter segment.
pairs.afterCap: The current screen renders T, shows W–L–T and the orange tie segment/key, adds Ties, and preserves the 53.7% half-win rate.

changes.h: A tie is no longer a hidden null
changes.was: The source [T] marker was not parsed, so the completed women's soccer event had no official result and disappeared from resolved Scoreboard games.
changes.now: [T] parses to TIE, is backfilled only for source-backed rows with null results, and remains auditable in rawSummary.

changes.h: Every scoreboard surface shares the result
changes.was: W/L-only aggregates, filters, records, and native models could not represent the source outcome consistently.
changes.now: Profile/team aggregates, W/L/T filters, web/native bars and badges, streaks, and Codable payloads all carry the same additive tie contract.

changes.was: Making ties required immediately would make older server responses fail native decoding during a server-first rollout.
changes.now: Native summary and breakdown decoders default an absent ties field to zero until the server rollout is complete.

verification: Behavior: full Vitest suite passes: 550 files / 3,756 tests; focused Scoreboard/calendar/native contracts pass: 9 files / 194 tests.
Web: npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false, zero-warning npm run lint, npm run build:app, migration-prefix validation, codemap generation/check, and git diff --check pass.
Native: Xcode project check, iPhone 16 Pro / iOS 26.5 app build, and focused WisconsinTests/ScoreboardModelsTests pass.
Visual: matched before/after captures come from the existing fixture UI test; the baseline is clean HEAD plus the identical tie fixture, and both images were inspected before inclusion.
notes: The live Preview diagnosis found the Aug 23 Men's Soccer vs Oakland [W] row already present in Nolan Kromke's personal Scoreboard; the missing resolved game is Women's Soccer vs Marquette [T].

No production database write, migration deploy, Vercel deployment, commit, or push was performed. Apply migrations 0132/0133, read the repaired row back, deploy the server/web route, and repeat authenticated production/native proof before closing GAP-71.
The review is native-fixture proof of the UI contract. It does not claim that the production scoreboard is fixed until the migration and server rollout gates are completed.
